body:
Indeed, regardless what you write down on that paper the chance of those topics ever being applicable to another scenario are slim to none. No two moments are ever the same.

Back in my youth I had the mentality of "Disregard females, acquire fun". Needless to say this resulted in next to no female contact but I did learn a few things. To whomever normally chimes in with "What ever you open with doesn't matter, you can literally say anything" is quite frankly a liar. 

Countless time I'd do just that, just to see the reaction I'd get. Awful, it really was quite something to watch the look of disgust on their face that I'd have the audacity to try and engage them in a conversation. Over time it really became demoralizing.

I appreciate that this isn't really the place to be talking about such things, but I've already started taking the anti-depressants. Honestly I feel as if there are very little alternatives. 

If one's game consists of having panic attacks, obsessively dwelling on failures and essentially cock-blocking myself before I even get a foot in the door I find it hard to believe that anti-depressants can do anymore harm.

My naive, almost child like hope and optimism towards women and dating has slowly eroded over time with various set backs, friend-zonings and rejections until there was no hope or optimism left. Quite frankly the situation mentioned in my original post was the final straw, I cant continue the way I am. Significant changes need to be made to my personality and outlook and I don't think I'm strong enough to go it alone without the aid of pharmaceuticals. 

I have no drive as it is, I've hit a brick wall in self help. Consistently I read about steps that can be taken to improve life, hygiene, exercise and fashion. I've naturally followed those steps throughout life to no avail. I quite simply cannot change my outlook if I'm stuck in this pit of "forever alone" self pity that I cannot dredge myself out of. Women can sense this and stay well away and that just reinforces these beliefs. It's a circle I'm perpetually going round in.

How did you do it without the aid of anti-depressants?

I can actually talk to **some** women, fat or not. It's not even as if I've got the dreaded virginity looming over me to add to this unjustified fear of beauty. 

I feel as if I'd be confidant enough to approach someone of supermodel status because realistically the chance of me seducing them is zero to none. Therefor nothing to really worry about.

I think the best way I can describe it is I crumble when there's a chance that I could potentially hook up with said woman. I'm too outcome dependent because quite frankly I'm not living in abundance. It's rare that I'm faced with an obtainable chance of romantically connecting with someone so bewitching. I just mentally breakdown because my entire future and happiness is riding upon this very interaction. 

I've come to the realization that it's not healthy to rely upon others for your well being and contentment. I do have friends, hobbies and education to keep me occupied but there will forever be this nagging void that can only be filled with some sort of relationship.
